classification.difficultyReason: Follow the explicit cosine-rule-then-area sequence using an unrounded angle.

content.prompt: Use cosine rule to find an angle, and hence calculate the area of this triangle to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Dark grey unfilled downward-pointing triangle, horizontal upper edge, three exterior side labels. No vertex labels or angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Upper side 4.3 m; left side 4.7 m; right side 5.6 m.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle opposite the $4.3\,\mathrm{m}$ side.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{4.7^2+5.6^2-4.3^2}{2(4.7)(5.6)}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{34.96}{52.64}\right)\approx48.4^\circ\end{align*}$$
Using the unrounded angle,
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12 ab\sin\theta\\A&=\frac12(4.7)(5.6)\sin\!\left(\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{34.96}{52.64}\right)\right)\\A&\approx9.8\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$
